about: Team-ups: a pair move for every named fusion, unlocked the first time it’s stitched. Data only until Phase 6 (COMBAT.md §2.8).

teamups.name: Synthwave Blackout
teamups.text: A Dark 3×3 for 2 rounds; foes inside turn Drowsy 1 on a Hit or better.

teamups.name: Overclock
teamups.text: An ally is Quickened this round and gains 40 heat.

teamups.name: Tech Noir
teamups.text: Every hidden intent and Unseen foe revealed; one foe Exposed 2.

teamups.name: Moonlit Duel
teamups.text: Noon fires twice this round, in the dark.

teamups.name: Starless Moor
teamups.text: A foe is sent sideways out of the fight for a round on a Hit or better, never a Tale-lead.

teamups.name: The Company Again
teamups.text: A Glimmer of Tamsin, Brannoch and Pell: everyone is patched for the 2-action line and every reaction returns.

teamups.name: Crew Colossus
teamups.text: The Titan finale, with Hana calling the shots.
